inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: A child was observed sleeping with a pacifier that had a clip attached in their mouth during nap time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2501(5))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: CCR observed a employee not their hands after changing a diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: CCR observed a caregiver in the infant room not sanitize the changing table in between changing diapers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: A caregiver was observed pulling a child by their arm and kicking the nap cot while the child was on it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: Caregivers in 2 out of 4 rooms observed provided the incorrect number of children in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space: Insufficient walking space was observed in the infant and toddler groups. The ends of some cots were observed to be touching each other.    NOTE: Corrected at inspection, the cots were rearrged to provide enough walking space
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space (26 TAC §746.2909(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: I observed unlabeled cribs used for children enrolled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A signature is needed on the food allergy emergency plan for one child enrolled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The operation utilizes a numbered cot/chart system for nap. During today's inspection I observed children asleep on numbered cots however the cot did not match the posted chart.     A number/child assignment map was not available in the Pre-K and Fours classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During nap time, children were observed sleeping behind a shelving unit. The shelving unit obstructed the caregiver's view, preventing the caregiver from maintaining visual supervision of the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space: There was no sufficient walk and work space between cots in the Infant B classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space (26 TAC §746.2909(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Updated feeding instructions are needed for eight children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: The PM snack menu showed children would be served fresh apples and sun butter. During today's inspection children were served oranges and crackers as well as oranges and pancakes for PM snack.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions (26 TAC §746.3313(1))

occurrences.finding: Provide care consistent with child's habits, interests, strengths, special needs, including any special supervision needs: During the investigation, it was determined that the operation failed to maintain adequate supervision of a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver did not wash their hands after diapering a child. The caregiver was beginning to diaper another child.   Note: This was corrected during inspection. The caregiver washed their hands before diapering the next child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Upon entering an infant classroom, one caregiver was observed with ten children ages 14-19 months old. The specified age group for the class was 12-17 months which allows one caregiver to supervise a maximum of 5 children. The caregiver was over ratio by 5 children.     A caregiver in another classroom was observed with 9 children ages 13-20 months old. The specified age group for the class was 12-17 months which allows one caregiver to supervise a maximum of 5 children. The caregiver was over ratio by 4 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child did not wash their hands after having their diaper changed.     Note: This was corrected during inspection. The child washed their hands before returning to play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: Equivalency documentation is needed for three caregivers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1111)

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: During today's inspection I observed stored medications that were expired. Note: This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The last fire inspection was completed 08/26/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Health statements are needed for two children enrolled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: 1 out of 4 children's files evaluated did not contain a completed health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Documentation PEDIATRIAC CPR-1st aid original certificate on file at center or copy available if licensing requests: 2 out of 4 staff files evaluated did not contain documentaiton of CPR and First Aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation PEDIATRIAC CPR-1st aid original certificate on file at center or copy available if licensing requests (26 TAC §746.1329(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: Documentation showing the smoke and carbon monoxide detectors were tested in June and July of 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A caregiver was obsserved with 8 children in the Toddler C classroom. The child to caregiver ratio should've been 5:1. The caregiver was over in ratio by 3 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was observed in the Toddler classroom with direct access to children. The caregivers background check has been inactive and the operation has not received an eligibility notification from CBCU stating the caregiver can be present.    Note: The caregiver left the operation during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Pre-service Training for Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months: 4 caregivers files evaluated did not contain documenation showing training was completed in Early Childhood Brain Development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pre-service Training for Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months (26 TAC §746.1305(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: A yellow bucket of dirty mop water was observed in the toddler room during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: An aerosol spray can of Goo Off Graffiti was used in a classroom causing a strong chemical odor in a room where children are present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The annual sanitation inspection has not been conducted since May 9th, 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space: The nap cots children were resting did not provide sufficient walking space during the inspection.    Note: The operation rearranged the cots during the inspection to allow for sufficient walking space.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space (26 TAC §746.2909(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was observed in a classroom with direct access to children. There is no active background check for the caregiver and the operation has not received an eligibility notification from CBCU.     Note: The caregiver left the operation during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Provide Access to Children's Records - Licensing: The operation did not provide CCR access to an incident report upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Access to Children's Records - Licensing (26 TAC §746.601(c))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: A TV was observed on top of a shelf leaning on the wall and was not mounted or anchored.     Note: This was corrected at the inspection when the caregiver removed the TV from the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over (26 TAC §746.3701(10))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver did not practice good judgment when sending a child home with the incorrect bottle of milk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: 2 out of 10 children's files evaluated did not contain a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: 1 out of 10 staff files evaulated did not contain a notarized affidavit for employment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Training Requirements - Original Training Certification Card or Letter in each Employee's personnel record: Training certificates were not available for review upon request for 10 staff files evaluated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Original Training Certification Card or Letter in each Employee's personnel record (26 TAC §746.1329(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: 1 out of 10 staff files evaluated did not contain a high school diploma.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Tweezers: The first aid kit evaluated during the inspection did not contain a pair of tweezers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Tweezers (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions: There are seven infants that did not have an updated infant feeding instruction.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §746.801(2))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Mats in the classrooms are labeled with numbers but there are no sleep charts to specify which mat belongs to which child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Storage for Individual Belongings: Cubbies in the Prek 4 classroom did not have labels to specify which cubbie belonged to each child. Children's blankets were placed together in one large cubbie or storage bin.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage for Individual Belongings (26 TAC §746.4505)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions: There are four infants that did not have an updated infant feeding instruction. They were last signed in July and August 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §746.801(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: I observe caregiver present that was missing current background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: Based on the information obtained during investigation, it was determined staff did not supervise children when a child was left unsupervised in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: Based on the information obtained, it was determined caregiver left children unsupervised in the toddler room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Based on the information obtained, it was determined child-staff ratios not met in the toddler room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
